uniqueFindings.title: Multi-token whitelist aggregates the nudge-pot so a per-token-safe owner funding can breach the snipe margin in aggregate
uniqueFindings.summary: story-025 pays the ENTIRE pre-loop pot of EVERY whitelisted nudge token to the qualifying recipient in one count>=nudgeSize batch. The known nudge-snipe footgun (858e9e80, wont-fix) was reasoned PER TOKEN: each pot must stay a fraction of the nudgeSize mint cost so a snipe is net-negative. Under the multi-token whitelist the snipe sweeps SUM(all whitelisted pots) for one fixed qualifying cost, so the safe threshold is now the AGGREGATE pot, not per-token. An owner who funds N tokens each individually under the per-token margin can unknowingly breach the margin in aggregate and make a front-run snipe profitable.
uniqueFindings.footgunFraming: Law-3 NON-OBVIOUS owner footgun (in scope): a competent owner reasoning per-token would be surprised the safe threshold is now the whitelist aggregate.
uniqueFindings.distinctnessRationale: KEPT DISTINCT FROM PATTERN-001/858e9e80 per run brief. 858e9e80/PATTERN-001 = per-token count-gated fixed-pot snipe footgun (already wont-fix). DEDUP-22-01 = NEW multi-token AGGREGATE amplification from story-025 whole-whitelist payout - different root-cause class (cross-token summation), related not duplicate; do NOT over-merge.
uniqueFindings.provenance: econ-scanner ECON-22-01; corroborated by ECON-VER-03/04 and code-scanner CODE-VER-07

uniqueFindings.title: swap-and-pop whitelist remove reorders _nudgeTokens; positional minRewards[i] can bind to the wrong token across an owner remove+add race
uniqueFindings.summary: setNudgeTokenWhitelist uses swap-and-pop on remove (line 224), reordering _nudgeTokens. batchMint binds minRewards[i] positionally to _nudgeTokens[i]; a caller (or owner remove+add-in-window) using stale ordering supplies a per-token floor against the wrong token. Value impact bounded: minRewards is a FLOOR only and the whole pot is paid regardless - UI/ordering footgun (self-DoS / mis-floor), not a protocol value leak. CODE-VER-07 confirms _nudgeTokenIndex maintained correctly and minRewards length-checked (no OOB / wrong-token payout).
uniqueFindings.mergeRationale: PATTERN-MR-002 (pattern-matcher whitelist swap-and-pop reorder) and BMT-LOCAL-01 (profiler owner remove+add index-race) are the SAME root cause and location. Merged per run brief.
